scripts.dev: SILVER_WORKSPACE=${SILVER_WORKSPACE:-$HOME} concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.electron:dev: SILVER_WORKSPACE=${SILVER_WORKSPACE:-$HOME} concurrently -n server,electron -c yellow,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE npm run electron:dev --prefix client"
